subject: Clarify MSA/Order Form: training exclusion, output rights, and feedback license
messages:
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Ravi Shah <ravi@amity.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-16T08:12:00-07:00
Subject: Clarify MSA/Order Form: training exclusion, output rights, and feedback license

Ravi - thanks again for the redline. We reviewed with Legal and Sales this morning and want to confirm a small set of principle asks so we can close the Order Form by end of next week. Attachments: Amity_MSA_redline_v2.docx (our marked-up MSA), OrderForm-Amity-terms.xlsx (pricing + term sheet).

High-level asks (numbered for quick reference):
1) Training exclusion (Section 6.3 in your draft) - customer asks a clear opt-out: they want Redwood NOT to retrain models on their Customer Data or derived outputs. They will accept aggregated telemetry for safety/infra improvements, but not training for model improvement. Please confirm language that accomplishes this.
2) Output ownership - Amity requests assignment for outputs used in their product. We can offer a broad, perpetual, non-exclusive license back to the customer with carveouts for Redwood internal benchmarking and safety. Need to align on exact phrasing.
3) Feedback license - we propose a narrow feedback license limited to bug fixes, detection improvements, and anonymized aggregate signals, not for model training. Proposed language: Customer grants Redwood a limited, non-exclusive, royalty-free license to use Feedback solely to improve the Service's security, reliability, and non-creative system performance.

Can you confirm which of these are acceptable and propose specific redline text you prefer? Karthik/Laura - flagging for negotiation guardrails (pricing impact if we accept a full training ban) and for legal to prepare fallback language.

Thanks,
Grace O'Connor
Lead, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
(Attachment: Amity_MSA_redline_v2.docx)

From: Ravi Shah <ravi@amity.ai>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Maya Linton <maya.l@amity.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-16T10:14:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Clarify MSA/Order Form: training exclusion, output rights, and feedback license

Grace - thanks for the clear summary. Quick responses below; our counsel added notes in the attached redline.

1) Training exclusion: Amity's position is that Customer Data and Customer Outputs must both be excluded from any training or weight update activity. We are okay with Redwood using strictly aggregated telemetry (latency, crash rates, anonymized token counts) for reliability and billing. We want explicit prohibition on using outputs or prompts for model training.

2) Output ownership: Amity requests assignment of rights to Outputs (including derivative product content) so they can ship in their commercial product. If assignment is not acceptable to Redwood, Amity will take an exclusive, perpetual license.

3) Feedback license: Open to the narrow language you proposed but want a carve for security incident response and safety fixes (Redwood may use Feedback to develop signatures/rules and push service updates).

Timing: procurement needs a signed Order Form by 2026-09-24 to meet their deployment window.

Best,
Ravi Shah
Head of Legal, Amity Systems
(ravi@amity.ai)

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ravi Shah <ravi@amity.ai>, Maya Linton <maya.l@amity.ai>
Date: 2026-09-16T11:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Clarify MSA/Order Form: training exclusion, output rights, and feedback license

Team - quick legal read and suggested compromise language below. I'll upload a tracked-redline to Drive after you confirm. Summary: we can accept a customer training opt-out but need a narrowly scoped telemetry carve for model safety and regression detection, and we should avoid assignment of IP for Outputs across the board.

Suggested compromises (high level):
- Training exclusion: Redwood will not use Customer Data or Customer Outputs to perform model re-training or weight updates intended to improve its general-purpose models. Redwood may use aggregated, anonymized telemetry (examples: request latency histograms, anonymized error classifications, aggregate token-frequency metrics) for reliability, security, and billing purposes.
- Output rights: Offer Customer a perpetual, non-exclusive, worldwide, transferable license to use Outputs for commercial purposes, with an explicit exclusion that Redwood retains the right to use Outputs for safety/regression analysis and to provide the Service. Avoid assignment language.
- Feedback license: Customer grants Redwood a limited, non-exclusive, royalty-free, worldwide license to use Feedback solely to fix defects, improve Service reliability, and remediate security issues; such Feedback will not be used to train or improve Redwood's models for general capabilities without Customer's explicit opt-in.

Action items / risks:
- If Amity insists on assignment or an exclusive license for Outputs, we need to escalate pricing - this materially reduces our ability to productize learning from the customer. Karthik, advise on pricing uplift percent if we accept exclusive assignment.
- Confirm whether Amity accepts the proposed telemetry examples.

I'll prepare the tracked redline for the MSA and a clean Order Form clause to insert once we have confirmation.

- Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ravi Shah <ravi@amity.ai>, Maya Linton <maya.l@amity.ai>
Date: 2026-09-16T13:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Clarify MSA/Order Form: training exclusion, output rights, and feedback license

Quick commercial note - full assignment or an exclusive license for Outputs is a non-starter at our standard price. If Amity requires exclusivity or assignment, we should: apply a 35-50% price uplift to the Order Form OR offer a time-limited exclusive (12 months) followed by non-exclusive rights, plus a marketplace revenue-share clause.

On training exclusion: we can accept the opt-out but need to preserve the ability to use anonymized aggregate signals to maintain model safety and SLOs. Recommend offering an annual model-improvement license as a commercial opt-in.

Karthik
Sr. Director, Sales - Strategic Accounts

From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Ravi Shah <ravi@amity.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Maya Linton <maya.l@amity.ai>
Date: 2026-09-17T14:23:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: proposed redline and next steps

Ravi / Maya - thanks for the quick turnaround. We've pulled together a single set of proposed redline snippets below to keep procurement on schedule. If you can confirm by COB Monday 2026-09-20 we can finalize the Order Form by 2026-09-24.

Proposed snippets:
1) Training exclusion: Customer Data and Customer Outputs shall not be used by Redwood to train, fine-tune, or update the weights of Redwood's general-purpose models intended for redistribution or resale. Redwood may use aggregated, anonymized telemetry metrics (latency, error-classification counts, anonymized token-frequency summaries) for Service reliability, security, and billing. Use of Customer Data or Outputs for model training requires a separate written opt-in and commercial agreement.

2) Output license: Customer is granted a perpetual, non-exclusive, worldwide, transferable license to use Outputs in Customer products and services. Redwood reserves the right to use Outputs internally for safety/regression analysis and to provide the Service, but shall not assert ownership of Output content produced by the Customer's use of the Service.

3) Feedback license: Customer grants Redwood a limited, non-exclusive, royalty-free license to use Feedback solely to fix defects, improve Service reliability, and address security incidents. Feedback will not be used by Redwood to improve model capabilities absent express written opt-in from Customer.

Action items:
- Laura to upload tracked-redline MSA (ETA: Thu EOD).
- Grace to produce clean Order Form insert with the license language (ETA: Fri 2026-09-18).
- Karthik to draft pricing language for both assignment/exclusive license scenario and model-improvement opt-in fee (ETA: Fri 2026-09-18).
- Ravi / Maya to confirm acceptance of telemetry examples and whether assignment is mandatory for Amity's internal compliance.

Thanks,
Grace O'Connor
Lead, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
(Attachment: OrderForm-Amity-terms.xlsx)
